scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run validate:release && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.test:development-gate: python -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_development_gate.py' && node --test scripts/development-identity.test.mjs artifacts/evexia-portal/src/development/compatibility.test.js artifacts/evexia-portal/src/development/releaseState.test.js
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
